explanation: Compared against WOWII Conjecture 315: for connected G with n > 1 and pendant set P, if α(G) = |P| then G is well totally dominated (every minimal total dominating set is minimum, per WOWII def 99). IsWellTotallyDominated says all minimal total dominating sets have equal size, which is equivalent. The Lean statement omits n > 1. That is harmless: a connected one-vertex graph has α = 1 and |P| = 0, so the hypothesis fails. Faithful.
